tenderSchedule.title: Supply of A/C and non A/C vehicles on monthly hire charges basis for the use of EE PD Hassan and AEEs, Project Sub division, Hassan and Channarayapattana for the year 2026-27.
tenderSchedule.description: Supply of Etios/ Mahindra Verito/ Maruthi Swift Dezire with AC 2021 and onwards Model One for Executive Engineer, Project Division Hassan and Two non A/C for Assistant Executive Engineer,Project Sub division, Hassan and Assistant Executive Engineer,Project Sub division Channarayapatna

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Vehicle should be supplied to Office of The Executive Engineer, Project Division, Hassan, Assistant Executive Engineer, Project sub division, Hassan, and Assistant Executive Engineer, Project sub division, Channarayapatna for implementation of PMGSY/NGNRY Schemes in Alur. Arkalgud, Arasikere, Belur, Channarayapatna, Hassan, Holenarasipura and Sakaleshpura taluk.

Interested firm / agency are invited to submit the offer for supplying of vehicle for hire on monthly basis. Your proposal will form the basis for ultimately drawing a contract between you and the client

Vehicle supplying firm / agency should have obtained official trade license in their name and submit certified copy. Also PAN card , GST registration copy and bank account should be in the same name and certified copy to be submitted. Vehicles should have official permit from respective RTO, Fastag and license for current year

Three Nos.Toyota Etios/Maruthi Swift Dezire/Mahindra Verito with AC and Non AC 2021 and onwards Model respectively for Division office and two Sub division offices has to be supplied. Vehicle along with driver should be in possession of the concerned officer and its movement is regulated by the officer. In case of vehicle taken on lease, supporting documents shall be provided
Hiring period of the vehicle is for 12 months or any further order whichever is earlier
The running km of vehicle is up to 2500 Kms /Month for Division and Sub Division Office
Hire charges of vehicle will be paid on monthly basis to a maximum of Rs . 40,000/- per month.(Division Office) and Rs.35000/- per month.(Sub Division Office)

Hire charges of vehicle are inclusive of fuel, Crew, maintenance, repairs, Insurance Charges, Drivers cost, drivers bata, toll charges on highways, etc., Any hike in fuel, spares, etc is included in the agreed rate. No extra claims shall be made

The Driver of the vehicle should posses valid driving License. He should not have any bad habits and should be healthy. He should not use mobile during driving and be obedient to officers. Whenever situation demands, driver should work even on Sundays or holidays as per instructions of officers. But no extra amount will be paid for working on holidays

If vehicle supplied is under repair, it is the responsibility of the supplier to provide alternate vehicle. Same driver should drive vehicle every day. Only in circumstances beyond control, alternative driver shall be sent for duty. Any accident met with during running of vehicle for office work should be taken care of by supplier and department or officers will not take any responsibility on this
This notification is subjected to any further orders from government from time to time
It is the sole responsibility of the tender to keep all documents updated and in order for which this office is not held responsible in the event of any checks or accidents
After Agreement is made for this office use, the vehicle must not be used for private hire basis for that stipulated agreement period
Payments will be made after receiving bill through K2 online payment to supplier Account
In the event of any loss or damages due to accident, this office or the Government is not responsible for any loss occurred
After accepting the lowest tender, no advance amount will be released
The owner shall fully comply with the various relevant provisions of the labour, like EPF, ESI act etc
Stipulated income tax and GST will be deducted as per norms
Necessary arrangement such as carrier should be provided so as to convey lab equipments to the site at any time.
In case of halts outside the jurisdiction the owner should make necessary arrangements for the stay of the driver at his own expense

Driver should maintain a log book / trip sheets and enter the mileage performed and obtain signature of the person / official allowed in the vehicle and must be present time to time at the offices even in holidays also

During the tender Process, Executive Engineer Project Division, Hassan is empowered to take final decisions, whatever so without assigning any reasons. All powers are rested with Executive Engineer Project Division, Hassan to accept or reject the tender
Any addendum issued shall be part of the bidding documents and shall be deemed to have been communicated to all bidders who have moved this tender to their My Tenders area
Registration copy issued by Labour Department in Form C and identification of each vehicle Drivers must be uploaded
The agencies must upload soft copy of Schedule B Provided in kppp portal after quoting their rates for each vehicle seperately including all taxes
